# Bombas

> > Bombas designs and sells premium comfort essentials—socks, underwear, t-shirts, and slippers—with a mission to donate items to people experiencing homelessness.

Bombas is a B Corporation-certified apparel company focused on creating high-quality basics with innovative comfort technologies like Stay-Up Tech and compression support. The brand combines product excellence with social impact through its BeeBetter initiative, which has donated over 150 million items to those in need.
